recordConversion.input: One connected-provider source record with a non-empty unique subset of the catalog-admitted outputs actually present.
recordConversion.atomicity: Every present output is validated before construction; any failure rejects the whole conversion without a partial graph.
recordConversion.provenance: Exactly one conversion Provenance targets every output emitted for the source record.
recordConversion.ordering: Catalog order is used only for deterministic serialization and has no FHIR semantic meaning.
recordConversion.fetchBoundary: Provider clients, authentication, pagination, webhooks, and raw response models remain outside grove-fhir.

statuses.implemented: A closed public builder emits resources conforming to the listed v0.6.0 profile.
statuses.implemented-recording: The closed native-recording builder emits the exact Sensor + Provider DocumentReference graph for this catalogued provider source token.
statuses.profiled-not-admitted: The shared profile exists, but this adapter facade has no supported provider source.
statuses.adapter-profiled: Version 0.6.0 defines an adapter-owned or standard-plus-adapter profile claim; it is intentionally not a shared Mobile profile and is outside this Provider facade.
statuses.planned-shared: The concept is shared by multiple sources but has no admitted v0.6.0 Grove builder.
statuses.adapter-specific: The semantics are source-specific and must not be collapsed into a shared concept.
statuses.sensor-ig: The concept belongs to the Sensor and Waveform contract.
statuses.not-in-scope: The source exposes the record, but it is not a mobile measurement admitted by this package.
statuses.platform-exclusive: The measurement is owned by one adapter and is emitted only through that adapter's exact Provider facade row and owner-specific semantic profile; it is outside the shared Mobile facade.
